acceptance_authority: The user-supplied base reference image is the sole likeness authority. The named image-faithful Blockbench mesh is the canonical editable realization and must not be simplified for Minecraft.

comparative_selection.required: Use blind_review_protocol_v01.json before selecting between two geometry candidates.
comparative_selection.rule: At least two fresh-context reviewers make an ordinal primary-plus-diagnostic verdict before candidate IDs, score, overlay or provenance are revealed.
comparative_selection.metric_policy: Exact primary-contour metrics diagnose an individual candidate only. They cannot rank candidate classes, break a blind tie or override an ordinal visual verdict.

contour_contract.source: The visible subject contour and major visible anatomical boundaries in the pinned base-reference pixels.
contour_contract.construction: Trace the primary-camera envelope and major volumes directly into an organic mesh at image-appropriate precision; do not use a low-detail cuboid approximation or Minecraft-style simplification.
contour_contract.comparison: Uniformly align the solid Blockbench projection to the pinned subject bounds and inspect the generated reference/model overlay.
contour_contract.hard_gate: A material mismatch in aspect ratio, ground line, dorsal envelope, mass balance, dominant limb contour or silhouette negative space rejects the iteration.

biomass_collector.primary_view: low front-left three-quarter; match the low, broad stance before adding detail
contour_landmarks: Low leading drape from the front head to the ground.
Six separately readable dorsal sac arcs forming one descending back envelope.
A long low underbody with thick leg arches and clear ground contacts.
A narrow trailing tail whose contour stays subordinate to the shell masses.
landmarks: Six large overlapping dorsal shell sacs that read as separate masses rather than as surface noise.
A very low, broad body carried by thick, tapered, articulated legs.
A heavy draped front head and hanging feelers distinct from the dorsal silhouette.
A thinner trailing rear tail that stays subordinate to the body masses.

crusher_stalker.primary_view: low front-left three-quarter; preserve the forward crushing weight
contour_landmarks: One steep armoured front wedge descending into the compact head.
A continuous hunched dorsal arc tapering toward the rear.
Two oversized crushing forelimbs dominating the lower-front contour.
Bent rear legs and thin trailing tendrils remaining secondary to the forequarters.
landmarks: A low, corded humped torso with a clear front-to-rear mass gradient.
Oversized, armour-like crushing forequarters that lead the silhouette.
A compact, downward-facing front head rather than a separate generic block.
Hunched rear legs and narrow trailing tendrils that do not compete with the crusher arms.

scythe_stalker.primary_view: crouched near-side profile with a slight front offset; the horizontal body axis and hooked foreground scythes must remain unmistakable
contour_landmarks: A compact front-biased dorsal hump over a low horizontal thorax.
Two broad foreground scythes forming continuous downward and inward hooks.
Six separated angular walking legs with readable negative spaces.
A narrow rear body and fine trailing whips that do not enlarge the main mass.
landmarks: A compact crouched body under a distinct arched dorsal crest.
Two long, broad, downward-hooked scythe forelimbs with a readable inner curve.
Six spidery articulated legs that remain separate in the primary silhouette.
Fine trailing whips that frame the body without replacing the large silhouette.
